## PID-stabilized Arduino drone

A drone built from scratch in the second year. An Arduino Nano reads an MPU-6050 and runs a PID controller that adjusts the speeds of the Emax 1400 kV motors through 20 A ESCs, keeping the drone balanced.

```{=html}
<figure class="vid solo"><div class="vid-frame"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/0sFj53kYxH0" title="Implementing PID Control for an Arduino-Based Drone | Flight Stabilization Project" loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe></div><figcaption>PID flight stabilization · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0sFj53kYxH0">Watch on YouTube</a></figcaption></figure>
```

## Wireless gesture-controlled LEDs

A hands-free controller from the second year. An MPU-6050 reads hand motion, calibrated to gestures, and an nRF24L01 radio sends it to a receiver that lights the LED for each gesture.

```{=html}
<figure class="vid solo"><div class="vid-frame"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4Ue-JYL8B6Y" title="Wireless Gesture-Controlled LEDs with MPU-6050 and nRF24L01 | Arduino Project" loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe></div><figcaption>Gesture-controlled LEDs · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Ue-JYL8B6Y">Watch on YouTube</a></figcaption></figure>
```

## Analog overweight alarm

An analog weight measuring system from the second year, second semester of my BSc. A DIY pencil-and-foil flex sensor, an LM741 comparator and a 555 timer sound a buzzer when the weight exceeds a set limit.

```{=html}
<figure class="vid solo"><div class="vid-frame"><iframe src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/jDCNBo2pa-c" title="Analog overweight alarm with a DIY flex sensor, LM741 and 555 timer" loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe></div><figcaption>Analog overweight alarm · <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jDCNBo2pa-c">Watch on YouTube</a></figcaption></figure>
```

## 4026 decade counter and 4053 multiplexer ICs

A video tutorial from the fourth year, first semester of my BSc, on the 4026 decade counter with built-in 7-segment decoder and the 4053 triple 2-channel multiplexer.

## Analog line follower robot

A first engineering project from the first year. It uses no microcontroller, only an L293D motor driver, IR sensors and a cardboard chassis.
